This page runs entirely in your browser. Nothing is uploaded anywhere and it needs no internet. Enter your real products, attach the photos you want used, then download a single ZIP. Send that back and it drops straight into the shop.

        03

        Download and send it back

        Everything stays on this computer until you send the file

        Inside the ZIP

        • catalog.data.json — the catalogue itself.
        • images/<product-slug>-01.jpg — each photo, already cropped and named.
        • whatsapp-catalog.csv — the same products as a feed for your WhatsApp Business catalogue, so you do not type them twice.
        • INTEGRATION-NOTES.txt — what you typed, plus any problems and your notes.

        What happens after you send it

        1. The products, photos and price checks are loaded into the shop and rebuilt.
        2. You get a preview link and approve what you see before anything is public.
        3. Only then does the catalogue go live on the site and in the WhatsApp catalogue.

        This builder is one standalone file. Closing the tab is safe — your work is kept in this browser and reloads next time — but a browser is not a backup: download the ZIP when you are done. Photos are cropped to 4:5 and resized to at most 1600 px tall before being included, so the ZIP stays small enough to send. Keyboard: Ctrl/⌘ + S downloads the ZIP, Alt + A adds a product.
